replaces: as2 (3 tiers, 34 bases). Backup: attack_speed_as2.json. as1 backup: attack_speed_as1.json

player.classNote: No class differences: every class starts with a weaponSpeed 0 starter at exactly 1.89 APS; class identity comes from skills and gear.
player.weaponSkillNote: weapon skills (cleave, bladedance, execute, rupture, blindrush, javelin, aimed, smite) take swingSeconds*1.15 (replaces the old +2 frames on 13)

formula.aps: clamp(baseAps * (1+weaponSpeed/100) * (1+ias/100) * (1+shrine/100) * (1+stride/100) * (1+boundIas/100) * (1-tradeoffIas/100) * tr(boundTradeoff()), apsFloor, apsCap). Every source is its own factor (fully multiplicative); ias = player.ias (gear + passives summed as today).
formula.hitSeconds: swingSeconds * hitFrac (clip hitFrac = clips[clip].hitT/clips[clip].dur; bow uses sets.bow.hitFrac)
formula.cast: castRate = clamp(baseCastRate * (1+fcr/100) * (1+knell/100) * (1+stride/100) * (1+weaponCastSpeed/100), castFloor, castCap); castSeconds = 1/castRate. fcr = round(gearFcr*100).
formula.weaponSpeed: item.wspd if number, else bases[item.base].weaponSpeed, else 0. Items with no line roll [-10,-5,0,5,10] + tierBonus.

tierBonusNoLine.note: only for items whose base has no entry in bases; line bases carry their own per-tier weaponSpeed

formula.reqStat: Cs(): reqBrawn when bases[base].reqStat=="brawn", else reqMark (same split as today wsm>=0)
formula.damage: dmgHi = max(1, floor((6+rand*5) * rarity.m * (1+(ilvl-1)*0.13) * Zo[tier] * 100/(100+weaponSpeed) * (weight>=1.5 ? 1.12 : 1))); dmgLo = max(1, floor(dmgHi*(0.55+rand*0.12))). Replaces go(16,0,wsm)/16 in ws(). Zo = normal 1, exceptional 2.15, elite 3.8.
formula.dpsParity: damage*APS is constant per tier and ilvl across all lines (floor rounding only); lines with weight>=1.5 (Timber Axe, Yew Longbow) keep the existing two-hand x1.12.
formula.animation: two-segment timeScale: before clip.hitT ts = hitT/hitSeconds, after ts = (dur-hitT)/max(0.02, swingSeconds-hitSeconds). No timeScale clamp; at 10 APS ts reaches ~15-30, valid for AnimationMixer. __up masks while moving.
formula.elite: elite tier only drops in Hell (ls(): elite -> exceptional when difficulty !== hell); an upgrade path (normal->exceptional->elite, same line) re-derives weaponSpeed and damage from this table.

drop.hell: not end: T3 65% T2 29% T1 6%; alvl>=183 or a Margin area: T4 20% T3 60% T2 16% T1 4%

labels.note: band of (weaponSpeed - speedShift[tier]); each base stores its label and keeps it across tiers
